question: The authorized Layout A fixture contains two nonzero transaction-bearing rows for which PdfPig exposes no description evidence in the deterministic row band, while FR-INGEST-FINANCIAL-NORMALIZATION requires missing descriptions to block. Should the owner provide a source export with extractable descriptions, provide authoritative out-of-band descriptions under a newly reviewed provenance contract, or remove Layout A from the v1 supported set?
context: bd-1as private golden verification accounted for all 16 ordered dates, running balances, and controls, but exactly two rows cannot produce normalization-ready FinancialEvidence without borrowing a distant statement-control line. OCR, adjacent-row guessing, blank descriptions, and weakened assertions are prohibited. The adapter fails closed when row-band description ownership is absent or ambiguous.
decision: Dirk selected a source re-export with extractable descriptions. Layout A remains in the v1 supported set, and execution may resume only when the authorized ignored private fixture re-export satisfies the existing unique row-band description evidence contract. Out-of-band descriptions, OCR, borrowing, blank values, and weakened assertions remain prohibited.
